description: Black/White checklist for TGRAM agents. WHITE = allowed corrections. BLACK = never modify, delete or replace.

known_fixes.diagnosis: actions/setup-python with cache: pip needs a requirements.txt or pyproject.toml.
known_fixes.solution: Create requirements.txt in repo root (requests, python-dotenv).

known_fixes.diagnosis: Old scorecard-action version pulls its image from gcr.io, which is no longer available.
A key used in code is missing from the environment.
known_fixes.solution: Run auto_heal_env.py (appends empty key to .env.example) and add the value as a GitHub secret.

known_fixes.diagnosis: Python dependency missing on the runner.
Bot push raced with another push.
known_fixes.solution: Run git pull --rebase before git push in the bot step.

known_fixes.diagnosis: GITHUB_TOKEN lacks permissions for this job.
known_fixes.solution: Add the needed permissions: block (e.g. contents: write) to the workflow.
